name: Bryan Steil
bio: a Representative from Wisconsin; born in Janesville, Rock County, Wis., March 3, 1981; graduated from Joseph A. Craig High School, Janesville, Wis., 1999; B.S. Georgetown University, Washington, D.C., 2003; J.D., University of Wisconsin, Madison, Wis., 2007; staff, United States Representative Paul D. Ryan of Wisconsin, 2003-2004; lawyer; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-present); chair, Committee on House Administration (One Hundred Eighteenth and One Hundred Nineteenth Congresses).
